content:
maria: Heads up — we've been seeing sustained fragmentation on shelf-22 in eu-west1. GPUs are allocated but small fractional slices left scattered across racks, causing ~18% usable capacity loss for Dedicated pools.

devon: ugh. noticed increased tail latency for a few tenants this morning, looks like placement can't coalesce. any recent scheduler changes?

anil: no scheduler deploys in the last 48h. telemetry shows a lot of tiny leftover allocations from short-lived experiments (5–20s jobs) that we didn't compact. KV cache usage spikes too.

maria: here's the rough signal from oomkube: 
```
shelf=22 free_slots=12 total_slots=64 fragmented_slots=9 fragment_loss=0.18
hot_tasks=14 short_allocs_per_min=42
```

lucy: could we do a proactive compaction job that drains low-util racks and packs long-lived tenants together? would need canary to avoid impacting SLOs.

anil: propose SLO-driven remediation: 1) mark fragmentation_metric>0.12 -> trigger soft drain on candidate hosts 2) move low-weight ephemeral allocations to warmpool 3) pack eligible reserved tenants together with affinity hints 4) monitor 99p latency during move and abort if breach.

devon: solid. what's the rollback path? last thing we want is cascading preemptions.

maria: rollback = stop compaction, reprovision placements using previous weights, and temporarily raise burst capacity for affected tenants for 1h. Also maintain 30min cooldown between compactions per rack.

anil: ETA for a PoC canary that targets 1 rack: ~tomorrow afternoon. I'll script the compactor to use soft eviction + prefer migration over preempt when possible.

lucy: include a dry-run mode that emits the plan without executing (so product can review tenant moves). also add cost-estimate for egress and runtime impact.

maria: good call. also tag tenants with "no-migrate" so we skip regulated customers. ops-bot, can you create the incident tracker and smoke test checklist?

ops-bot: created INC-2026-1377 with checklist: dry-run plan, 1-rack canary, 2h watch, rollback steps, communication to tenants. :white_check_mark:

devon: what about downstream routing constraints? when we move GPUs cross-rack we may hit NIC oversubscribe. need prechecks for current egress utilization.

anil: compactor will consult egress_meter and only move if post-move estimated egress < 70% of interface capacity. if not, it'll skip and mark for manual review.

maria: plan summary: PoC tomorrow afternoon on shelf-22 rack-3, dry-run first, then soft-drain migration window with egress prechecks. goal: reduce fragment_loss <10% without 99p latency regression. ops: ping customers at T-1h if their workloads are in plan.

lucy: I'll draft the customer note and post to #customer-success once the dry-run output is available.

devon: logging reminders: tag all migrations with trace_id=frag-<ts> and include before/after placement metrics.

anil: will do. sample command for dry-run: 
```
./compactor --shelf 22 --rack 3 --dry-run --trace-id frag-1768001234
```

maria: thanks team. let's keep the canary small and watch the 99p and egress. ping me with any red flags. :eyes:
